project.Title: DD Preset Tools
project.ItemDescription:
[h1]DD Preset Tools[/h1] Trinket Sets, Party Lineups and Auto Buy for the town.
[b]One-time setup required:[/b] close the game, open this mod's folder and run [b]dd_preset_tools\install\install.bat[/b]. It puts a small loader (SDL2.dll) next to Darkest.exe, which loads dd_preset_tools.dll from this mod's folder. Run it again after a game update or "Verify integrity of game files".
[list] [*][b]Trinket Sets[/b] - save up to 10 two-trinket sets in the trinket bag and equip them from the hero screen in one click. Class-exclusive trinkets are respected (mod classes too). [*][b]Party Lineups[/b] - save up to 10 four-hero lineups on the Estate Map and load them into the party. [*][b]Auto Buy[/b] - buy your usual supplies on the Provision screen in one click (edit dd_preset_tools/autobuy.txt). [*]Sets and lineups are saved per estate. Enable/disable in the mod list like any other mod. [/list]
Source code: https://github.com/tester7823/DD-Preset-Tools
